uncertainty: Four distinct pinned C package paths passed the valid 2x1 RGBA PNG control, each returning dimensions and both decoded pixels. This is a first batch, not the 20-parser goal or a most-used ranking of all C PNG parsers. The Conan Center Index recipe-name search saved all 11 alphabetically matched hits from the three listed substrings (100-result ceiling per query); it is not a usage-ranked registry search and can miss parsers whose recipe names omit these terms or are outside Conan Center. Six named leads remain unresolved: FreeImage, ImageMagick, OpenImageIO, SDL_image, upng and pngle. Repository stars rank only the four verified rows and are an imperfect adoption proxy. The four paths represent libpng, stb_image, LodePNG and libspng parser families; libspng uses zlib for compression but its own PNG parsing. The control covers one non-interlaced 8-bit RGBA PNG only. WG14's C standard library documents no PNG-specific parser; generic stdio reads do not qualify. No malformed-input, vulnerability or resource-use experiments were run.
